rationale: The plan correctly treats the QuantSeq counts as length-independent, feeds raw counts into DESeq2 Wald with median-of-ratios inside the model, ~condition with control as reference, BH at 0.05, apeglm shrinkage, and states the low-power caveat and that TPM/FPKM do not apply. QC (library sizes, PCA, distance heatmap, flag-not-drop outlier policy) precedes the test. The low-count filter uses the generic full-length floor (>=10 in 3 samples) rather than the lower floor appropriate for a 3' tag library, though it is reported. The stricter DE call applies a |shrunken LFC| >= 1 cut post hoc instead of an lfcThreshold in the test. Enrichment, though not requested, is reasonably specified (Wald-stat ranked full list, tested-gene universe for ORA, named versioned collection, ID match fraction) but omits a gene-set size window.
